ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Obfuscated IEX Invocation - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects all variations of obfuscated powershell IEX invocation code generated by Invoke-Obfuscation framework from the following code block \u2014 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX("$PSHome[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$PSHome[") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("$ShellId[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$ShellId[") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("$env:Public[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$env:Public[") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("$env:ComSpec[(\s*\d{1,3}\s*,){2}") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("*mdr*W\s*).Name") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX("$VerbosePreference.ToString("))
